summary: Recent campus crime data for Boise State University indicates an uptick in incidents involving violent behavior, particularly battery and robbery, with multiple cases reported in the last week. Notably, two battery-related incidents occurred on November 20 and November 23, alongside a robbery, suggesting a concerning trend in aggression on campus. Additionally, drug-related offenses remain prevalent, with several cases of drug paraphernalia possession and alcohol violations reported, reflecting a consistent pattern observed in previous months. The disposition of many cases remains open, indicating ongoing investigations. Compared to earlier months, the frequency of violent incidents appears to have increased, warranting further attention from campus safety and administration.
